_meta.proposito: JSON prompt para Gemini 2.5 Flash Image — genera 24 vistas turntable del producto + product sheet 6x4
_meta.origen: How to Handle Impossible Product Shots
_meta.api_keys: Google AI API key (GOOGLE_API_KEY) — o usar directamente en Gemini con Google AI Studio
_meta.como_usar: Reemplazar PRODUCT_REF_1 con imagen del producto (frontal, fondo limpio); reemplazar PRODUCT_URL_OPTIONAL con URL de la página oficial del producto; reemplazar PRODUCT_NAME_AND_MODEL con el nombre exacto

priority.primary: Create an ultra-consistent 360° packshot of the same product (product consistency) plus a ready-to-use e-commerce '360° product sheet'.
priority.secondary: Rely on reliable online information (exact product name, materials, official colors, design details) to avoid any shape or branding errors.

reference_images.notes: Cleanest possible photo, main front view of the product, good studio-like lighting.

optional_inputs.notes: Official product page or manufacturer link if available.
Example: 'Sony WH-1000XM5 Black' / 'Dyson Airwrap Complete Long Nickel/Copper'.

research_goals: Identify the exact product name and model/reference
Verify overall silhouette, proportions, textures (matte/plastic/metal/glass), logo/typography and placement
Confirm official colors, finishes, and relevant variants (do NOT mix variants)
Collect 3-5 reliable reference images (manufacturer, major retailers, trusted reviews) strictly for visual validation

lighting.notes: Clean e-commerce look, no dramatic contrast.

transformations.action: Clean the reference image: remove dust/imperfections, correct white balance, unify pure white background, keep the product unchanged.
transformations.validate: Product matches the reference exactly, crisp edges, uniform white background, soft realistic shadow.

transformations.action: Generate a 360° turntable sequence: create 24 views (same exact product) at 15° increments around the vertical axis (0° to 345°). Product stays centered, same scale, same horizon, same shadow.
transformations.validate: Between frames, only rotation changes. No drift in shape, color, logo, or texture. Perfect consistency.

transformations.action: Assemble a '360° product sheet' (contact sheet) on white background: 6x4 grid (24 frames) with even margins. Add minimal header: product name + model + official color (web-verified only).
transformations.validate: Clean e-commerce-ready sheet, perfect alignment, no invented information.

success_criteria: 24 perfectly consistent frames with no product identity drift
Clean, uniform white background across all images
Product name/model/color included only if web-verified (omit otherwise)
